== Ingredients ==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable]] or [[Cookbook:Peanut Oil|peanut oil]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 200 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Shrimp|shrimp]], peeled
* 300 g [[Cookbook:Broccoli|broccoli]], cut into florets and rinsed
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Oyster sauce|oyster sauce]]

== Procedure ==

# Heat a pan, add the oil and garlic, and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] until golden.
# Add the shrimp and broccoli. Season with salt and oyster sauce, and add a little water. Stir together.
# Put on a plate and serve.
